title: Crafting a wearable solar cell device and the challenges of its integrity developments
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, 9,2838-2869
DOI: 10.1039/D4SE01249F, Review Article
Tahta Amrillah, Albert Rafael, Moch Falah Putra Hani, Prisma Megantoro
